basic_info.description: Elegant 2-Bedroom, 2-Bath Condominium on Prestigious Arguello Boulevard    Ideally situated just steps from Rossi Park, this sophisticated residence combines timeless charm with modern luxury. Thoughtfully renovated, the home showcases brand-new engineered hardwood floors, beautifully remodeled bathrooms, and a sleek chef's kitchen appointed with quartz countertops and premium stainless-steel appliances.    The open layout is designed for both comfort and style, with abundant natural light enhancing the refined finishes throughout. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, private parking, and generous storage. A rare opportunity to enjoy elevated city living in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.
